notes.title: 10th October, Update. "New Free Race Mode", and Bug fixes !!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196214/27a5ce90a9ae32b800a6ebb4f390ccb22467130c.png[/img]

[b][h2]*New "Free Race Mode" :[/h2][/b]
    - you can start a race in any map you choose with your customized character.
    - new characters from story has been added to the customization, you can pick them for teh free mode race
   - new Cool Hud Icons.

[b][h2]*Bug Fixes:[/h2][/b]
   - mouse bugs with menus.
   - the bug when you click on "Next" Button in the story, also you can now press "Space" to make it much easier.
   - the blank avatar and customization in the story mode.
